title: Spicy Jjim Dumplings with Onions and Pancake
description: A twist on traditional dumplings, these Spicy Jjim Dumplings are filled with a flavorful mixture of onions and pancake, then steamed to perfection.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the chopped onions, crushed pancake, jjim sauce, vegetable oil, ginger paste, garlic paste, and salt. Mix well.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and pliable.
Divide the dough into small balls and roll them out into thin circles.
Place a small spoonful of the onion-pancake mixture in the center of each circle.
Fold the dough over the filling and press the edges together to seal the dumpling.
Steam the dumplings for 10-12 minutes or until they are cooked through.
Serve the dumplings hot with a side of chutney or raita.
